dataset.name: Notional Maritime Production & Support Challenge — Information Object Library
dataset.fictionalisation_notice: All procedures, technical values, torque values, tests, safety notes, drawing descriptions, revisions, applicability rules and instructions are fictional. They are intentionally simplified for hackathon prototyping and must not be used as real technical, maintenance, safety or engineering guidance.
dataset.generated_for: Industrial AI Hackathon — Operational Co-pilot Challenge

information_objects.title: APR-220 Interface Module Installation Procedure — Revision B
information_objects.summary: Legacy synthetic procedure for earlier APR-220 configurations. It is intentionally retained to support an obsolete-document and revision-mismatch demonstration.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Isolate rack power using the approved local isolation point. 2. Remove the existing interface module. 3. Install bracket type B. 4. Tighten four mounting fasteners to the synthetic value of 80 Nm. 5. Connect interface harness route B. 6. Record module identifier in the installation report.
information_objects.warning: Do not use with configuration revision D.

information_objects.title: APR-220 Interface Module Installation Procedure — Revision D
information_objects.summary: Current synthetic procedure for APR-220 configuration revisions C and D. It supersedes the earlier bracket and torque arrangement.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Confirm installed rack configuration revision C or D. 2. Isolate rack power and verify zero-energy state. 3. Fit bracket type D and verify cooling-line clearance. 4. Install the interface module. 5. Tighten four mounting fasteners to the synthetic value of 95 Nm. 6. Connect interface harness route D. 7. Record module identifier and procedure revision in the installation report. 8. Release the rack for post-maintenance test.
information_objects.warning: Applicable only when the configuration record confirms revision C or D.

information_objects.title: APR-180 Sensor Module Installation Procedure — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Synthetic installation procedure for the APR-180 configuration-C forward sensor rack.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Verify rack configuration revision C. 2. Isolate power and apply ESD controls. 3. Remove failed module using the approved lifting method. 4. Install the replacement module using bracket type C. 5. Tighten mounting fasteners to the synthetic value of 90 Nm. 6. Connect harness route C and inspect strain relief. 7. Update the module traceability record. 8. Release for functional and configuration test.
information_objects.warning: Use only with APR-180 configuration revision C.

information_objects.title: Sensor Processing Rack Post-Maintenance Test Procedure
information_objects.summary: Synthetic mandatory test procedure following replacement or installation of an APR module.
information_objects.content_text: Perform the following synthetic checks: 1. Visual installation confirmation. 2. Power-on and self-test. 3. Interface continuity check. 4. Cooling-path status check. 5. Synthetic signal-path verification. 6. Record pass, fail or conditional result in the test report. A failed or conditional result blocks maintenance-package closure.
information_objects.warning: Do not close the maintenance package without an accepted result.

information_objects.title: Sensor Rack Configuration and Maintenance Closure Procedure
information_objects.summary: Synthetic closure procedure ensuring that installed configuration, technical evidence and post-maintenance testing are linked before return to service.
information_objects.content_text: Before closing the maintenance package: 1. Confirm task completion. 2. Confirm the installed module identifier and configuration revision. 3. Confirm the applicable installation procedure revision. 4. Attach the accepted post-maintenance test result. 5. Record deviations or engineering-review requests. 6. Update the synthetic as-maintained configuration record.
information_objects.warning: Closure is blocked if required evidence is absent.

information_objects.title: APR-220 Interface Module Mounting Arrangement — Revision B
information_objects.summary: Text-only synthetic drawing description showing legacy bracket-B and harness-route-B arrangement.
information_objects.content_text: Synthetic drawing description: module sits on left-side rail pair; bracket type B interfaces with rear mounting points; harness route B passes below the cooling manifold. The arrangement does not include clearance for the revision-D cable route.
information_objects.warning: Legacy drawing description; not applicable to revision-D installation.

information_objects.title: APR-220 Interface Module Mounting Arrangement — Revision D
information_objects.summary: Text-only synthetic drawing description showing bracket-D, revised cable route and required cooling clearance.
information_objects.content_text: Synthetic drawing description: module sits on reinforced left-side rail pair; bracket type D interfaces with revised rear mounting points; harness route D passes above the cooling manifold; a visible clearance gap must be confirmed before energisation.
information_objects.warning: Use only with revision-C or revision-D configuration.

information_objects.title: APR-180 Sensor Module Mounting Arrangement — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Text-only synthetic drawing description for the APR-180 revision-C sensor-rack arrangement.
information_objects.content_text: Synthetic drawing description: module is installed on forward rail points using bracket type C. Harness route C terminates at the upper interface panel. Maintain strain relief at the entry point and preserve access to the cooling-service panel.
information_objects.warning: Applicable only to APR-180 configuration-C equipment.

information_objects.title: Cooling Distribution Unit Inspection Procedure — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Synthetic inspection procedure for cooling routing, mounting condition and service-panel access.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Verify system isolation where required. 2. Inspect cooling-line routing for chafe, bend or obstruction. 3. Confirm synthetic clearance of at least 40 mm from the adjacent cable route. 4. Verify mounting fasteners are visually secure. 5. Confirm the service panel remains accessible. 6. Record any deviation and raise corrective work if needed.
information_objects.warning: Do not assess clearance while equipment is in an unsafe access state.

information_objects.title: Cooling Distribution Routing Rework Procedure — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Synthetic corrective procedure for a routing or clearance deviation identified during CDU inspection.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Isolate the cooling distribution unit. 2. Remove affected line supports. 3. Re-route the line using approved synthetic fittings. 4. Restore a minimum 40 mm clearance from cable routes. 5. Refit supports and visually inspect. 6. Release the unit for functional verification.
information_objects.warning: Functional verification is mandatory after rework.

information_objects.title: Cooling Distribution Unit Functional Verification
information_objects.summary: Synthetic test procedure verifying restored flow, absence of visible obstruction and accessible service configuration.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Restore the unit to approved test condition. 2. Perform synthetic flow check. 3. Confirm no abnormal condition is indicated. 4. Confirm cooling-line clearance remains visible. 5. Record result and attach inspection evidence. A failed result requires a new corrective-maintenance task.
information_objects.warning: Do not return the unit to service after a failed result.

information_objects.title: CDU-90 Cooling Distribution Routing Description — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Text-only synthetic drawing description for CDU-90 route, supports and service-panel clearance.
information_objects.content_text: Synthetic drawing description: cooling inlet enters from lower port side, follows the rear support rail and rises to the distribution unit. Cable routes occupy the upper-right path. The cooling line must maintain a 40 mm synthetic clearance and may not obstruct the service panel.
information_objects.warning: Use with CDU-90 configuration-C equipment only.

information_objects.title: Auxiliary Power Conversion Unit Safety Inspection — Revision B
information_objects.summary: Synthetic safety inspection for the auxiliary power conversion unit.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Establish lockout/tagout boundary. 2. Verify hot-surface protection is intact. 3. Inspect warning labels and access covers. 4. Confirm emergency isolation access is clear. 5. Inspect visible cable strain relief. 6. Record all findings in the inspection report.
information_objects.warning: Inspection must not begin until isolation is verified.

information_objects.title: MCS-NX-500 Hardware Update Kit Installation — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Synthetic hardware-update procedure requiring configuration matching and electrostatic-discharge controls.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Confirm approved change package and console configuration revision C. 2. Back up the current software baseline. 3. Establish ESD controls. 4. Install the revision-C hardware update kit. 5. Verify connector seating and cable segregation. 6. Record the kit identifier. 7. Release the console for the matching software-baseline update.
information_objects.warning: Do not install a mixed-revision update kit.

information_objects.title: Mission Console Update Readiness Checklist
information_objects.summary: Synthetic readiness checklist for a linked hardware and software update sequence.
information_objects.content_text: Checklist: approved change package present; hardware revision confirmed; current software backed up; update media verified; ESD controls active; test window allocated; rollback contact identified; post-update test procedure available.
information_objects.warning: Do not initiate update when required readiness items are incomplete.

information_objects.title: MCS-NX-500 Software Baseline SW-4.0 Update — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Synthetic software update procedure applicable only when the matching revision-C hardware kit has been installed and verified.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Confirm revision-C hardware update evidence. 2. Verify software backup. 3. Load synthetic baseline SW-4.0 using approved update media. 4. Record checksum confirmation. 5. Restart the console. 6. Verify displayed baseline. 7. Release the console for functional acceptance test.
information_objects.warning: Do not apply SW-4.0 before matching hardware revision is confirmed.

information_objects.title: Mission Console Functional Acceptance Test
information_objects.summary: Synthetic functional acceptance test following hardware and software updates.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Confirm console starts normally. 2. Verify displayed hardware and software revision. 3. Run synthetic operator-interface check. 4. Run synthetic input/output check. 5. Confirm no active update warnings. 6. Record result and attach to the change package.
information_objects.warning: A mismatch between displayed configuration and change record must be escalated.

information_objects.title: MCS-NX-500 Hardware Update Arrangement — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Text-only synthetic arrangement description for the mission-console hardware update.
information_objects.content_text: Synthetic drawing description: update module is fitted in the rear service bay; signal harnesses use the upper cable channel; power harness uses the lower channel; maintain separation between the two routes and preserve access to the emergency shutdown path.
information_objects.warning: Do not obstruct the synthetic emergency shutdown access path.

information_objects.title: SCG-210 Configuration Verification Procedure — Revision E
information_objects.summary: Synthetic procedure for verifying gateway hardware revision, software baseline and applicable checklist.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Confirm hardware configuration revision E. 2. Read back software baseline from the local status view. 3. Compare hardware and software values with the approved synthetic configuration record. 4. Use checklist revision E only. 5. Record any mismatch and request engineering review. 6. Do not mark the configuration as verified if evidence is incomplete.
information_objects.warning: An obsolete checklist cannot verify revision-E equipment.

information_objects.title: SCG-210 Configuration Verification Checklist — Revision E
information_objects.summary: Synthetic configuration checklist for use with SCG-210 revision-E hardware.
information_objects.content_text: Checklist: hardware revision E confirmed; software baseline recorded; approved configuration record consulted; cable labels inspected; cooling clearance checked; prior deviation record reviewed; technician and configuration-controller sign-off captured.
information_objects.warning: Use only with the revision-E verification procedure.

information_objects.title: SCG-210 Configuration Verification Checklist — Revision C
information_objects.summary: Legacy synthetic checklist retained to support configuration-mismatch detection.
information_objects.content_text: Checklist: hardware revision C confirmed; software baseline recorded; cable labels inspected; technician sign-off captured.
information_objects.warning: Not applicable to revision-E gateway hardware.

information_objects.title: Auxiliary Cooling Pump Assembly Inspection — Revision B
information_objects.summary: Synthetic inspection procedure for pump mounting, line condition and visible leakage indicators.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Establish approved access boundary. 2. Inspect pump mounting condition. 3. Inspect line supports and visible connectors. 4. Confirm no synthetic leakage indicator is present. 5. Confirm access to local isolation. 6. Record findings. 7. Release for functional verification when no blocking finding remains.
information_objects.warning: Any unresolved finding blocks functional verification.

information_objects.title: Auxiliary Cooling Pump Functional Verification
information_objects.summary: Synthetic functional verification procedure for the auxiliary cooling pump after inspection or corrective work.
information_objects.content_text: 1. Confirm inspection findings are closed or formally accepted. 2. Restore to approved test condition. 3. Run synthetic pump-start check. 4. Confirm stable synthetic flow indication. 5. Observe for abnormal indication. 6. Record pass or fail result. A failed result requires corrective maintenance.
information_objects.warning: Do not run the test while an unresolved safety finding remains.

information_objects.title: ACP-140 Auxiliary Cooling Pump Arrangement — Revision B
information_objects.summary: Text-only synthetic arrangement description for pump access, isolation and line-support inspection.
information_objects.content_text: Synthetic drawing description: pump is mounted on a lower machinery skid; local isolation is positioned on the port-side service panel; line supports run along the upper frame; access path must remain clear for inspection and test activities.
information_objects.warning: Maintain clear access to the local isolation point.

information_objects.title: Sensor Equipment Bay Safety Notes
information_objects.summary: Synthetic safety notes for controlled sensor-equipment spaces.
information_objects.content_text: Use approved ESD protection when handling modules. Verify power isolation before access. Maintain a clear route to the emergency shutdown control. Use an approved lifting plan for modules above the synthetic 25 kg manual-handling threshold. Do not obstruct cooling-service access.
information_objects.warning: This synthetic note does not replace real safety procedures.

information_objects.title: Machinery Space Safety Notes
information_objects.summary: Synthetic safety notes for machinery-space inspections and maintenance tasks.
information_objects.content_text: Establish lockout/tagout before inspection or maintenance. Verify hot-surface protection before close access. Use hearing protection where posted. Maintain clear access to local isolation controls. Stop work if an unsafe condition or unplanned release is observed.
information_objects.warning: This synthetic note does not replace real safety procedures.

information_objects.title: Operations Room and Console Safety Notes
information_objects.summary: Synthetic safety and access notes for console and operator spaces.
information_objects.content_text: Use ESD protection when handling removable modules. Maintain cable segregation. Keep the synthetic emergency shutdown path clear. Confirm the approved change package before any update. Record any deviation before restoring the console to operator use.
information_objects.warning: This synthetic note does not replace real safety procedures.

information_objects.title: Electronics Equipment Room Safety Notes
information_objects.summary: Synthetic safety notes for electronics-equipment access and configuration checks.
information_objects.content_text: Authorised access is required. Apply ESD controls before touching removable modules. Maintain cooling clearance around racks. Do not alter cable labels during verification. Record any evidence gap or configuration mismatch for engineering review.
information_objects.warning: This synthetic note does not replace real safety procedures.
